independent_cultural_identity_audit.validation_cuts: No direct CulturalIdentity owner cuts. WMD, Improvements and complete Governors source grammars locate prefix from Quests.end; enclosing Player.end is contextual bound. No production trace offsets.
independent_cultural_identity_audit.allocation_policy: Fixed 60-byte grammar, zero dynamic items. Decode allocates nothing; encode preflights byte cap then fallibly reserves exactly 60 bytes.
independent_cultural_identity_audit.native_read_effects: Read invokes archive edit/virtual load wrappers; current version reads all members, Q8 via SetRaw. Codec does not edit native archives or initialize/reset parent.

limits_and_coverage: WMD/Improvements/Governors outer records are unhooked; their counts/source grammars are not presented as traced ends.
All first-Player raw Governor slots, IDs, type hashes, owners, packed CityIDs and free links match native nested header/instance cuts.
Governor raw slot transport is distinct from native AddAt masking/reserve/overwrite; native Write ascending unique slot invariant is not generalized to all accepted wire input.
Improvements final array_size remains independent of plot count; first record has157 plots and saved size0.
CulturalIdentity is exactly version10 plus14 signed words; five Q8 words retain raw bits; zero items.
Quests parent-only record does not exclude quest/NPC state/RNG elsewhere; source-only GPP/Influence branches remain qualified.
Component allocation/depth policies remain separate; inherited Unit allocation is not universally fallible; no cumulative typed heap cap.
Profile stops before Heroes; no post-Heroes flag/array/AI-block branch or complete43Player loop is inferred.
